title: Porsche expands all-electric SUV model lineup with the Cayenne S (Porsche newsroom US)
notes: Gross 113 kWh; up to 400 kW (390 kW optimal conditions), 10-80% under 16 min; J3400 (NACS) DC-only port driver-side rear fender, J1772 AC-only port passenger-side; Porsche CCS DC adapter standard. Usable and AC kW not stated; preconditioning only in Track mode context.
